text:
The independent JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 map identifies **98% of the mapped event area as forest before the reported 2021 loss**. This exceeds the method’s 50% agreement threshold. A later year was also observed in the annual series, satisfying the method’s other corroboration condition.

Uruguay’s 2021 MGAP forest map provides context: it classifies 68.1 ha of the 81.3 ha event area as planted pine forest, 13.2 ha as outside mapped forest, and none as native forest.

The JRC map corroborates the pre-loss forest cover, not the cause of the loss. The evidence does not establish whether the change was harvest, deforestation or another cause.
